baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive construction "وما علينا إلا" bounds the duty, while "البلاغ المبين" joins message-delivery to disclosure of meaning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ب ل غ delivery branch supplies transfer to addressees, and the ب ي ن disclosure branch specifies a form that makes the intended meaning available; the construction assigns that process, not assent, to the speakers.

activation_trace.role: Message-delivery is the literal branch and defines the assigned task as transfer to addressees.
Disclosure by speech or sign makes intelligible availability the required quality of the transfer.

changed_reading.before: Our only duty is to speak clearly.
changed_reading.after: Our accountable task is to get the message across in a form that discloses its intended meaning; the addressee's assent is not included in the stated duty.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "البلاغ" can name reaching a limit, and the separation branch of "المبين" resonates with the exception that fences off what is "upon us."
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival at an endpoint supplies a completion criterion, while separation gives that endpoint a jurisdictional edge: the speakers' burden terminates where completed conveyance becomes distinct from the hearer's response.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the destination turns conveyance from an activity into a task with a completion point.
Separation supplies the boundary between completed delivery and consequences outside the speakers' charge.

changed_reading.before: The messengers must continue trying to persuade.
changed_reading.after: Their bounded obligation is to carry the message to its communicative endpoint; persuasion and outcome stand on the other side of that boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speech-quality branches of both "البلاغ" and "المبين" allow the phrase to specify expression adequate to its intended point.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eloquence is functional rather than ornamental: wording reaches the intended meaning because it actively uncovers that meaning for another.

activation_trace.role: Eloquence that reaches the intended point supplies expressive adequacy rather than mere vocalization.
Meaning-disclosure makes successful expression the functional test of that adequacy.

changed_reading.before: Any utterance of the message discharges the duty.
changed_reading.after: The duty includes fitting expression to the intended meaning well enough that the utterance can actually disclose it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A packet branch permits "البلاغ" as sufficiency or subsistence, while "المبين" can mark what is exposed and available.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this form-distant branch, the speakers owe a sufficient means by which the addressee can get through, openly furnished but not forcibly consumed.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and subsistence recast conveyance as furnishing what is enough to continue.
Manifest availability keeps the proposed provision public rather than hidden or withheld.

changed_reading.before: The phrase concerns only verbal transmission.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can frame the duty as furnishing an openly available sufficiency by which hearers may make their way, without guaranteeing their use of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence constructs a blocked receiver: gaps are sealed, a cover overlays perception, sight fails, and warning does not produce belief. Clear conveyance therefore names completed sender-side availability, not successful receiver-side uptake.

activation_trace.role: Message-delivery remains the task whose completion must be distinguished from reception.
Disclosure makes the content available even when the receiver does not take it in.
Barriers that fill openings model a channel sealed at both approaches.
An overlying cover supplies the perceptual obstruction between available sign and receiver.
The parallel mapped covering branch confirms concealment as the receiver-side condition.
Failed ocular perception supplies the explicit non-reception outcome.
Warning normally awakens caution, so its repeated ineffectiveness exposes the gap between delivery and response.

structural_cues: 36:8-10 places shackles, two barriers, covering, failed sight, and unchanged unbelief before the focus claim.
36:11 distinguishes the hearer who follows the reminder from the unreceptive audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical obstruction, failed perception, and warning without belief; I map that spatial-perceptual sequence onto the communication channel and place the blockage after sender-side disclosure. A live alternative is that these images describe moral condition without defining the completion criterion of "البلاغ."

changed_reading.before: Clear delivery is complete only when the audience understands and responds.
changed_reading.after: Clear delivery can be fully performed while uptake remains blocked: clarity describes what the senders make available, not what the receivers permit to enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival, paired dispatch, reinforcement, and a completing third turn conveyance into a distributed delivery system. The plural speakers carry one obligation through redundant carriers rather than through one isolated performance.

activation_trace.role: Destination-reaching provides the success condition for the multi-carrier system.
Manifestation is the shared output produced by the reinforced carriers.
Actual arrival grounds the relay in completed movement toward the town.
Dispatch and emission identify the messengers as directed carriers.
Succession and segmentation sharpen the repeated dispatch into a relay architecture.
Joining one to one establishes the initial paired channel.
Reinforcement explicitly adds strength after the first pair is rejected.
The third as completer turns numerical addition into functional completion.

structural_cues: 36:14 sequences two carriers, rejection, reinforcement by a third, and a renewed plural declaration.
The focus construction retains the plural "علينا" after the relay has been reinforced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple dispatched carriers, rejection, reinforcement, and a third; I infer a reliability mechanism in which redundancy protects delivery from carrier-level failure. The live alternative is that the multiplication strengthens testimony rather than transport, though both alter the focus from a solitary utterance.

changed_reading.before: Conveyance is the act of whichever messenger happens to speak.
changed_reading.after: Conveyance is a collective, failure-resistant relay: carriers may be multiplied and reinforced so that the message reaches and stands manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing, remaining traces, exhaustive enumeration, and a manifest register supply a persistence layer. Delivery can satisfy its burden by leaving content inspectable after the speaking event rather than vanishing with the voice.

activation_trace.role: Message-transfer supplies the event that the contextual record can preserve.
Disclosure becomes auditable when its disclosed meaning remains recoverable.
Ordered writing gives transient action a durable, legible form.
A remaining mark supplies persistence after the originating act has passed.
The split branch of visible emanation adds propagation outward from the originating act.
Exhaustive counting supplies completeness and inspectability rather than an impressionistic trace.
The repeated manifest adjective ties visibility directly to the containing register.

structural_cues: 36:12 immediately precedes the messenger parable and combines writing, آثار, exhaustive enumeration, a containing register, and "مبين."
The focus repeats the same "مبين" form after the messengers state their bounded duty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written, exhaustive, manifest record and lingering آثار; I infer that durable recoverability can model how disclosure remains available after delivery. The live alternative is that 36:12 concerns divine accounting alone and does not prescribe a medium for the messengers.

changed_reading.before: Clear conveyance is a momentary oral performance.
changed_reading.after: Clear conveyance can include leaving a durable, enumerable trace by which the delivered meaning remains publicly recoverable and the act of delivery remains auditable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby refusal to request payment allocates the cost of transmission away from the recipient. What is "upon us" is therefore not a priced exchange but an obligation to make guidance accessible without an overt or hidden toll.

activation_trace.role: Delivery is the service whose burden the speakers accept.
Disclosure remains directly available rather than gated behind a transaction.
Direct asking supplies the explicit charge that the messengers do not make.
The split image of covert extraction extends the no-charge condition, exploratorily, to hidden tolls.
Compensation for work supplies the economic return explicitly absent from this delivery.

structural_cues: 36:21 follows the focus claim with an appeal to follow carriers who ask no wage.
The focus places the burden "upon us," while the next speaker denies a reciprocal charge upon the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded duty and an explicit absence of requested compensation; I infer a cost-allocation rule that keeps access unobstructed, with the split extraction branch raising the possibility of hidden tolls. The live alternative is that no wage proves sincerity only, without defining the economics of clarity.

changed_reading.before: The verse limits the messengers' task but says nothing about access conditions.
changed_reading.after: The task is a noncommercial public delivery: the carriers bear transmission and do not condition disclosed meaning on payment from its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: A man at the city's far edge moves intentionally toward the dispute and repeats the call to follow the messengers. Reaching the periphery thus generates reverse movement and a secondary human carrier, extending delivery beyond the original senders.

activation_trace.role: Reaching a distant endpoint enables the endpoint to become a new point of departure.
Message-delivery supplies what the secondary speaker recirculates.
The farthest side of the city marks successful reach to a peripheral endpoint.
Goal-directed movement turns reception at the edge into active return toward the audience.
The split possibility of undirected going remains a check, while the following imperative supplies the direction used by this model.
Following and coming after supplies the secondary speaker's repeated call.
Messenger and message identity links the man's appeal back to the original carriers.

structural_cues: 36:20 reverses the direction of movement: a man comes from the farthest part of the city toward the central audience.
His speech immediately repeats the imperative of following the original messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distance, directed movement, and a new speaker who repeats the call; I infer that prior delivery reached him and recruited him as a relay back toward the center. A live alternative is that he is an independent witness whose knowledge did not arise from the messengers' delivery.

changed_reading.before: Delivery ends when the original messengers address the town.
changed_reading.after: Delivery can propagate: once it reaches a peripheral hearer, that hearer may reverse direction and become a secondary carrier without becoming one of the original commissioned senders.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same manifestness branch qualifies opposing claims of error, and 36:47 mirrors the focus's exclusive syntax. "Mubin" therefore does not guarantee uncontested agreement; the communication event can make rival positions explicit while each side claims that the other's error is manifest.

activation_trace.role: Delivery creates the encounter within which opposed positions become speakable.
Manifestness initially marks what the messengers claim their conveyance achieves.
Deviation from guidance is one position explicitly labeled manifest.
The adjective makes the supporting man's counterfactual error openly exposed.
Opponents reverse the diagnosis and assign deviation to the believers.
The repeated adjective makes manifestness a contested predicate rather than a monopoly of one speaker.

structural_cues: 36:47 echoes the focus pattern with "إن أنتم إلا في ضلال مبين" after an opposing speech turn.
36:24 and 36:47 place the identical "ضلال مبين" diagnosis in opposed rhetorical alignments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated "مبين," opposed diagnoses, and a mirrored exclusive construction; I infer that clarity can disclose the dispute without coercively settling it. The live alternative is that the repetitions are formulaic emphasis and do not comment on the epistemic limits of clear speech.

changed_reading.before: A clear message should end dispute because its truth is self-enforcing.
changed_reading.after: Clear conveyance makes the message and the resulting alignments explicit, but manifest speech remains contestable and can even provoke a mirrored claim of manifest error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later denial of poetry and positive identification as reminder and clear recitation revise the eloquence baseline. Adequate delivery is repeatable, memory-reactivating articulation, not dependence on poetic genre or ornament.

activation_trace.role: Eloquence that reaches intent is retained but placed under a later genre constraint.
Meaning-disclosure remains the functional criterion after poetic form is excluded.
Poetic composition supplies the named genre that the passage explicitly denies.
Reactivation after forgetting makes the message mnemonic rather than merely novel.
Running remembrance on the tongue gives the mnemonic content a repeatable vocal path.
Recitation supplies the positive delivery medium paired with reminder.
The repeated clear adjective identifies that reminder-recitation as meaning-disclosing.

structural_cues: 36:69 parallels the focus's exclusion pattern: poetry is denied, then "إن هو إلا" identifies reminder and clear recitation.
The same "مبين" form links the focus's delivery quality to the later named medium.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit poetry denial and a positive reminder-recitation identification; I infer that rhetorical adequacy is subordinated to mnemonic, repeatable disclosure. The live alternative is that the verse distinguishes source and genre without reducing the legitimate role of eloquence.

changed_reading.before: The best model of clear conveyance is polished eloquence as such.
changed_reading.after: Its eloquence is instrumental and genre-bounded: clear conveyance works as repeatable recitation that reactivates remembrance, not as poetic performance pursued for itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command-speech makes what it addresses become, whereas the messengers' speech only conveys and manifests. This contrast sharpens the focus as an agency boundary: human delivery exposes meaning, but it does not ontologically produce the hearer's response.

activation_trace.role: Human speech is assigned transmission rather than causal production.
Human clarity makes meaning appear but does not make the addressed state exist.
Command and compulsion supply the directive force absent from mere human conveyance.
Uttered speech is the explicit causal interface of the closing formula.
The split paucity branch, exploratorily, sharpens the minimal verbal unit "كن" against extended human explanation.
Occurrence and presence supply the immediate realized output of the command.

structural_cues: The focus restricts the speakers with "ما ... إلا," while 36:82 uses "إنما" to state a command whose utterance is followed by realization.
36:82 places saying and becoming in direct sequence; 36:17 places conveyance and manifestness without a compelled audience response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded messenger speech and a closing command whose saying is followed by becoming; I infer a contrast between transmissive and performative agency. A live alternative is that 36:82 demonstrates creative power independently and is not meant to classify the messengers' speech acts.

changed_reading.before: Clear speech is deficient if it does not make its audience change.
changed_reading.after: The messengers' speech is complete when it conveys and exposes meaning; causally making a state obtain belongs to the distinct performative command displayed at the surah's close.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a discourse noun into transport and subsistence, but it remains anchored in the focus's ب ل غ sufficiency and endpoint branches and is unusually reinforced by a context branch that explicitly joins useful provision to "البلاغ." Render it only as a material analogy for transmission, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "علينا" can picture a carried burden, while "البلاغ" can name both reaching a destination and the sufficiency by which one gets through.

activation_trace.role: Destination-reaching provides the transport endpoint of the analogy.
Sufficiency and subsistence recast the message as usable provision for making the passage.
Bearing a trust or burden makes "upon us" materially legible as carrier responsibility.
A vessel moving through water supplies the medium that carries freight toward survival.
Loading to fullness turns content into entrusted freight rather than an abstract signal.
Useful provision for needs and "البلاغ" directly bridges survival equipment to the focus branch.
Sending resources outward in expenditure supplies circulation rather than hoarding.
Nourishing provision makes the freight something recipients can live by.
Feeding another supplies the final recipient-facing act in the provision chain.

changed_reading.before: The messengers hand over informational content.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they bear survival freight: sufficient guidance is carried through danger, made available, and circulated to recipients who remain free to refuse its use.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it projects a separation branch of "مبين" into a later social outcome, but it remains anchored in ب ي ن B001 and the explicit command to separate. Downstream prose should present it as a consequence-model of clear address, not as the ordinary lexical sense of "المبين."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ب ي ن separation branch permits the focus adjective to carry a discriminating edge in addition to semantic clarity.

activation_trace.role: Separation and parting supply the latent discriminating edge of manifest communication.
Delivery supplies the encounter through which positions can become distinguishable.
Explicit sorting until one group stands apart materializes the earlier separation image.

changed_reading.before: "Clear" only describes how understandable the message is.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, clear conveyance also acts as a discriminant: by exposing the address and responses, it makes positions separable before their later explicit sorting.

strongest_changes: The barrier sequence decisively separated completed clear delivery from successful reception.
The two-plus-third messenger sequence recast conveyance as a reinforced, collective relay.
The written manifest register activated durable and auditable disclosure rather than transient speech alone.
Repeated "مبين" in opposed claims showed that clarity can expose a dispute without coercively settling it.
The closing command distinguished human transmissive speech from divine speech that makes its addressed state obtain.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one short duty formula function across channel obstruction, relay redundancy, durable evidence, public access, rhetorical contest, genre, and agency. Its most unusual live branch treated "البلاغ" as survival provision or freight, supported by the ship, useful متاع, spending, and feeding sequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The durable-record model may import divine accounting into messenger practice more strongly than the sequence warrants.
The non-dominant ق ل ل mapping at 36:82 productively sharpens minimal speech but remains form-distant.
The freight and subsistence reading is packet-anchored yet should remain analogical rather than replace the primary message-delivery sense.
The sorting outlier may describe a consequence of response more than a semantic component of "المبين."
